objectives: Calculate the shares of the legal heirs in common family situations.
Explain the two forms of will and the conditions of their validity.
Calculate the reserved portion and the freely disposable portion.
Explain how an inheritance is accepted or renounced and why the notary does not receive these statements.
Explain the rules of partition among co-heirs and the risks of selling inherited property.

cards.front: When and where does an inheritance open?
cards.back: At the moment of **death**, at the **last domicile** of the deceased (Art. 1 ЗН).

cards.front: A man dies and leaves a wife and three children. What is the wife's share of his estate?
cards.back: **1/4**: a share equal to each child (Art. 9(1) ЗН). Her own half of the community property is not part of the estate (Art. 28 СК).

cards.front: Share of the spouse with parents after 12 years of marriage?
cards.back: **2/3** (1/2 if the marriage lasted less than 10 years) (Art. 9(2) ЗН).

cards.front: What do half-siblings receive compared with full siblings?
cards.back: **Half** of a full sibling's share (Art. 8(3) ЗН).

cards.front: An heir wants to renounce the inherited debts and keep the flat. Is that possible?
cards.back: **No**: a renunciation for a part of the inheritance is invalid (Art. 54 ЗН). The heir accepts **by inventory** to limit the liability to the value of the estate (Art. 60(2), 61 ЗН).

cards.front: Minimum age to make a will?

cards.back: Oral statement to the notary, **two witnesses**, reading, notes of formalities, place and date, signatures (Art. 24 ЗН).
Written **entirely by hand**, **dated**, **signed after** the dispositions (Art. 25(1) ЗН).

cards.front: A nephew comes with a power of attorney to take back his aunt's deposited will. What follows?
cards.back: Refusal: only the **testator personally** may take a deposited will back; the note in the register is signed by the testator, two witnesses and the notary (Art. 26 ЗН).

cards.front: Reserved portion with two children and no spouse?
Freely disposable portion with a spouse and three children?

cards.back: By a written statement to the **district judge** where the inheritance opened (Art. 52 and 49 ЗН).
**Three months** from learning of the opening, extendable by three months (Art. 61 ЗН).

cards.front: Effect of a partition without one co-heir?

cards.back: The surviving **spouse** and heirs in the **direct line** (Art. 31(2) ЗМДТ).

quiz.question: A man dies leaving a wife and three children. What does the wife inherit from his half of the common flat?
options: 1/4 of his half
1/2 of his half
All of his half
Nothing
quiz.explanation: Art. 9(1) ЗН: the spouse inherits a share equal to each child; with three children, four equal shares of 1/4. The other half of the flat is already hers as community property (Art. 28 СК) and is not inherited.

quiz.question: A woman dies after 6 years of marriage with no children. She leaves her husband and her father. What does the husband get?
options: Everything
quiz.explanation: Art. 9(2) ЗН: with parents or siblings, the spouse gets 1/2 when the inheritance opened before ten years of marriage and 2/3 after ten years; 1/3 applies when parents and siblings both survive. After six years: 1/2 to the husband, 1/2 to the father.

quiz.question: A grandchild whose father died before the grandmother: does the grandchild inherit from the grandmother?
options: Yes; by representation in place of the father
No; grandchildren never inherit while a child lives
Only by a will of the grandmother
Only half of the father's share, as a grandchild
quiz.explanation: Art. 10(1) ЗН: the descendants of a child who died before the deceased take the child's place without limit of degree, per stirpes. The grandchild takes the whole share of the father; a living child of the grandmother does not exclude the grandchild.

quiz.question: Which will is valid?
options: A will written entirely by hand, dated and signed at the end
A will typed on a computer, dated and signed at the end
A will written entirely by hand and signed, without a date
A will written by hand by two spouses and signed by both
quiz.explanation: Art. 25(1) ЗН: a holographic will is written entirely by hand, dated and signed after the dispositions; a typed text or a missing date makes it void (Art. 42). Two persons may not make a will in one act (Art. 15).

quiz.question: How many witnesses are needed for a notarial will?
options: Two
None
One
Three
quiz.explanation: Art. 24(1) ЗН: the notarial will is made before the notary in the presence of two witnesses, who must meet Art. 584 ГПК; the notary reads the will to the testator in their presence (Art. 24(2)).

quiz.question: May an assistant notary make a notarial will?
options: No; a will needs the notary personally
Yes, on the instructions of the notary
Yes, if two witnesses are present
Yes, but only outside the office
quiz.explanation: Art. 40(1) item 3 ЗННД excludes notarial wills and their revocation from the powers of an assistant notary; only the notary, or a registered substitute (Art. 46), makes a will.

quiz.question: A father with one child, a widower, wants to leave everything to a charity. What is the maximum the charity can receive against the child's will?
options: 1/2 of the estate
Everything
1/3 of the estate
1/4 of the estate
quiz.explanation: Art. 29(1) ЗН: with one child and no spouse, the reserved portion is 1/2; the freely disposable portion is the other 1/2 (Art. 28(2)). The child may ask for the reduction of the will beyond that (Art. 30).

quiz.question: Which gifts are reduced first when the reserved portion is affected?
options: After the wills, starting from the latest gift
Before the wills, starting from the oldest gift
Together with the wills, all gifts proportionally
Never; only wills are reduced, not gifts
quiz.explanation: Art. 32 and 33 ЗН: wills are reduced first, proportionally; gifts only when the wills do not suffice, starting from the latest gift. Transfers by the donee within a year of the opening may be set aside (Art. 37).

quiz.question: Where does an heir file a renunciation of an inheritance?
options: With the district judge where the inheritance opened
With any notary, by a certified declaration
With the municipality of the last address
With the Registry Agency, in the property register
quiz.explanation: Art. 52 with Art. 49(1) ЗН: acceptance and renunciation are made by a written statement to the district judge of the place where the inheritance opened, entered in a special book. The notary only certifies the signature on the statement when the heir does not file it in person.

quiz.question: An heir wants to renounce only the inherited debts and keep the flat. Is that possible?
options: No; renunciation of a part of the inheritance is invalid
Yes, with a declaration to the district judge within the term
Yes, with a declaration certified by a notary and entered
Yes, within three months of the opening of the inheritance
quiz.explanation: Art. 54(1) ЗН: acceptance or renunciation under a condition, with a term or for a part of the inheritance is invalid. The tool to limit liability for debts is acceptance by inventory (Art. 60(2), 61), within three months of learning of the opening.

quiz.question: Three heirs signed a voluntary partition of an inherited house, but a fourth heir was left out. What is the status?
options: The partition is entirely void
It is valid for the three signatories
It is voidable within one year
It is valid if the fourth heir is paid later
quiz.explanation: Art. 75(2) ЗН: a partition made without one of the co-heirs is entirely void, also between the three who signed. The one-year term concerns a partition challenged for a mistake of more than a quarter (Art. 74).

quiz.question: A nephew inherits from his aunt. Does he pay inheritance tax?
options: Possibly; 0.4–0.8% on the share above 250,000 лв.
No; nobody pays inheritance tax in Bulgaria
Yes; 3.3–6.6% on the whole inherited share
No; relatives are always exempt from the tax
quiz.explanation: Art. 31(2) ЗМДТ: only the surviving spouse and the direct line are exempt. A nephew is a child of a sibling: Art. 36 item 1 sets 0.4–0.8% on the part of the share above 250,000 лв. (127,822.97 euro); other persons pay 3.3–6.6% (item 2). Below the threshold no tax is due.
